dimensions.assessment: Affects federal agencies managing broadband funds, the FCC, the NTIA, and the public participating in the inquiry.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission shall seek public comment on the functionality and transparency of the map

dimensions.assessment: Mandates administrative data collection coordination, a public inquiry, and a comprehensive GAO review of interagency broadband funding tracking.
dimensions.evidence: conduct a study on the roles, responsibilities, and progress to date of Federal agencies to maintain the Broadband Funding Map

dimensions.assessment: Aims to promote efficient use of federal funds and prevent fragmentation, though no direct spending or revenue amounts are stated.
dimensions.evidence: promote the most efficient use of Federal funds for broadband deployment, and prevent inefficient use or fragmentation

dimensions.assessment: Directs specific federal agencies (FCC, NTIA, GAO) to perform structured inquiries, data collection evaluations, and reporting.
dimensions.evidence: The Commission, in coordination with NTIA, shall collect data submitted for the Broadband Funding Map... Not later than 180 days after the date of enactment... Comptroller General... shall conduct a study

dimensions.assessment: Involves near-term deadlines for inquiries and the GAO study (within 120 to 270 days) alongside ongoing data collection improvements.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 270 days after the date of enactment... initiate a notice of inquiry... Not later than 180 days... Comptroller General shall conduct a study

missing_information: Cost of conducting the GAO study and FCC inquiry.
Specific changes that will be made to map data categories following the inquiry.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the FCC and NTIA to improve data collection for the Broadband Funding Map, conduct a public inquiry on its functionality, and mandates a GAO study and report on federal broadband funding maps.
